overall_theory_links.chapter_description: A technical chapter providing overview of psychoacoustics, auditory perception mechanisms, sound pressure levels, hearing thresholds, and frequency-dependent auditory sensitivity. Covers reference standards (ISO 2005) for hearing thresholds across frequencies (20-18,000 Hz). No empirical research findings to extract.
